newsitem.title: FRANCE: Two French digital TV services in decoder deal.
newsitem.headline: Two French digital TV services in decoder deal.

text.p: Two of France's three operators of digital satellite television services said on Monday that they had signed a decoder deal allowing viewers to watch both groups' broadcasts with a single decoder and chip card.

Canalsatellite, a unit of Canal Plus, and private AB Sat, said they had agreed on a so-called "simulcrypt" deal which would from April allow AB Sat subscribers to take a Canalsatellite subscription without changing hardware, and vice versa.
The companies said they would remain fully independent.
The other digital satellite television services group in France is TPS, a joint-venture of TF1, France Television, M6 and CLT of Luxembourg.
